text:
deploy-bot: [AUTOMATED] Deploy attempt to production blocked. Service: rdx-api. Tag: v2.4.0-rc3. Commit: a1b2c3d. CI gate failed: integration-tests -> integration/smoke-payment (3 consecutive failures). Canary not started.

maria: seeing the same in CI dashboard, tests are timing out on payment gateway calls.

dan: @maria can you paste the failing test log? might be a mock stub issue after the env change.

maria: log excerpt: ```
FAIL test_payment_flow (tests/integration/test_payment.py::TestSmoke::test_charge)
AssertionError: expected status 200, got 504
Traceback...
requests.exceptions.ReadTimeout: Payment gateway did not respond within 30s
```

aj: tagging @sre-oncall — this looks like a downstream flake (external sandbox). If gateway is slow we should not proceed with canary.

sre-oncall: looking at infra metrics — payment-sandbox latency spiked at 10:12 UTC, ~5s -> 45s. There's a degraded instance in us-east-1. I'm spinning a replacement now.

release-manager: thanks. status: hold release window open? this is a scheduled push for 11:00 UTC otherwise we might need to push to next window.

maria: I can rerun the integration pipeline once the sandbox is healthy. Recommend pinning the tag if we can't get the sandbox stable in 20m.

deploy-bot: Retry queued: user=dan, command=`/deploy retry --tag v2.4.0-rc3 --env production` (will trigger new CI run)

ci-bot: New CI run started (build #7892) for tag v2.4.0-rc3. Triggered by dan.

aj: if retry fails again we should consider rollback to v2.3.9 (last known good). We need a quick rollback plan and a release note entry.

maria: agree. I'll prepare a hotfix branch if it's something in our change. If it's external, rollback is safest.

ci-bot: CI run #7892 finished: integration/smoke-payment -> FAILED (1 failure). Flaky threshold reached.

sre-oncall: replacement instance healthy, but external sandbox still intermittent. Ops reached out to vendor.

dan: given repeated CI failure and vendor ETA > 1h, decision: abort v2.4.0-rc3 prod rollout and pin prod to v2.3.9. @release-manager to update release notes and comms.

release-manager: copying note to release channel and updating the changelog: "Hold v2.4.0-rc3 — blocked by integration test failures depending on external payment sandbox. Rolling back to v2.3.9 for stability." Will schedule a follow-up postmortem if vendor issue persists.

maria: steps I ran to abort: ```
# pin prod back to last good tag
deployctl promote --env production --tag v2.3.9 --reason "CI gate failed for v2.4.0-rc3 (payment sandbox)"
# trigger smoke checks
deployctl smoke --env production --service rdx-api
```

deploy-bot: Promotion completed. production -> v2.3.9. Canary: n/a. All health checks passed.

aj: moving forward, add a retry/backoff for payment-sandbox dependency in our integration tests and mark tests as flaky with a ticket: INF-4821.

maria: created INF-4821 and linked failing test. Added test tag "flaky-external" and a note to docs about vendor sandbox expectations.

release-manager: communications: emailed stakeholders, updated release docs, and moved v2.4.0 to "on hold" in the release tracker. Closing this thread unless more appears. :white_check_mark:

dan: thanks everyone. Good runbook execution.

sre-oncall: vendor confirmed they're investigating; will post updates in #vendors. If they resolve within the change window we can retry without opening a new release window.

maria: ack, monitoring.

deploy-bot: Thread closed by dan.
